info.title: Directory service
info.description: Service that provides a register of services and APIs for service discovery.

post.description: Creates the directory namespace of the current user's tenant, with no entries. The namespace name is the tenant name in kebab case. Requires the directory-admin role in the user's tenant. The request has no body and the response has no body. Requires a tenant user or service account; core (platform) users have no tenant to create a namespace for.

400.description: The namespace of the tenant already exists.

example.errorMessage: Value not valid for Create new namespace: namespace test-tenant exists

403.description: User does not have the directory-admin role.

example.errorMessage: User Test User (ID: 7c3e1a52-1f0b-4bd3-9a41-2b8f6c5d9e10) not permitted to create namespace.

get.description: Retrieves all entries (services and APIs) of the namespace. Anonymous access is allowed; no role is required. Responds with an empty array when the namespace has no entries.

post.description: Adds a service entry to the namespace. Requires the directory-admin role in the tenant of the namespace; core users and users of other tenants are not permitted. Creates the namespace if it does not exist.

get.description: Retrieves the service entry with the metadata of the service. The directory requests the metadata from the service URL, and caches it for 5 minutes. Anonymous access is allowed; no role is required.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Name of the service, for example `form-service`.

400.description: A path parameter failed validation, or the service is not in the namespace. When the namespace has no directory, the response is the plain text `Bad Request`.

example.errorMessage: Value not valid for Update service: Cannot find service: form-service

424.description: The metadata could not be retrieved from the service URL, or it is not a JSON object.

example.errorMessage: Failed to fetch data from remote server

patch.description: Updates the URL of the service entry. Requires the directory-admin role in the tenant of the namespace; core users and users of other tenants are not permitted. Responds 201 with no body on success.

400.description: The service is not in the namespace.

example.errors: form-service does not exist in test-tenant

delete.description: Deletes the service entry. API entries of the service are not deleted. Requires the directory-admin role in the tenant of the namespace; core users and users of other tenants are not permitted. Responds 200 with no JSON body on success.

400.description: The namespace has no directory, or the service is not in the namespace.

example.errorMessage: Value not valid for Delete namespace service: Cannot find form-service

get.description: Retrieves the entry of the service and the entries of its APIs. Anonymous access is allowed; no role is required. Characters other than letters, spaces, and hyphens are removed from the service name before matching.

200.description: Service entry and its API entries.

service.description: Entry of the service, or null if only API entries are registered.

404.description: No tenant has the name of the namespace, or the namespace has no entry for the service or its APIs. The second case responds with the plain text `Not Found`.

example.errorMessage: directory namespace with ID 'test-tenant' could not be found.

post.description: Adds an API entry for the service, named `{service}:{api}`. The service entry does not need to exist. Requires the directory-admin role in the tenant of the namespace; core users and users of other tenants are not permitted. Creates the namespace if it does not exist.

api.description: Name of the API, usually its version.

get.description: Retrieves the entry of the service API. Anonymous access is allowed; no role is required.

404.description: No tenant has the name of the namespace, or the API is not in the namespace. The second case responds with the plain text `Not Found`.

example.errorMessage: directory namespace with ID 'test-tenant' could not be found.

patch.description: Updates the URL of the service API entry. Requires the directory-admin role in the tenant of the namespace; core users and users of other tenants are not permitted. Responds 201 with no body on success.

400.description: The API is not in the namespace.

example.errors: form-service:v1 does not exist in test-tenant

delete.description: Deletes the service API entry. Requires the directory-admin role in the tenant of the namespace; core users and users of other tenants are not permitted. Responds 200 with no JSON body on success.

400.description: The namespace has no directory, or the API is not in the namespace.

example.errorMessage: Value not valid for Delete namespace service: Cannot find form-service:v1

get.description: Retrieves the resources of the tenant. Requires the resource-browser or resource-tagger role in the tenant. Set criteria to an array of resource URNs to retrieve those resources in one request; URNs that are not found are left out, and paging parameters are ignored.

parameters.name: includeTags
parameters.description: Embed up to 10 tags of each resource.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: Criteria for the resources to return, as JSON: either an object, or an array of resource URNs. Responds 400 if an array element is not a valid URN.

get.description: Retrieves a resource of the tenant. Requires the resource-browser or resource-tagger role in the tenant.

delete.description: Deletes a resource of the tenant and its tag associations. The represented resource is not affected. Requires the directory-admin role in the tenant. Responds with `deleted: false` if the resource does not exist.

get.description: Retrieves the tags of a resource of the tenant. Requires the resource-browser or resource-tagger role in the tenant.
Retrieves the tags of the tenant. Requires the resource-browser or resource-tagger role in the tenant.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: URN of a resource; retrieves only the tags of that resource.

post.description: Tags or untags a resource of the tenant. Requires the resource-tagger role in the tenant. Tagging creates the tag and the resource if they don't exist. The resource URN must be under an API registered in the directory.

400.description: Request is invalid: a body parameter failed validation, the tag has no label or value, the resource URN is not a resource URN, or the URN's API is not registered in the directory.

example.errorMessage: Resource URL cannot be resolved. Associated API must be registered in the directory.

get.description: Retrieves a tag of the tenant. Requires the resource-browser, resource-tagger, or resource-resolver role. Core users with one of these roles are also permitted, and act on the tenant given by the tenantId parameter.

delete.description: Deletes a tag of the tenant and its associations with resources. Requires the directory-admin role in the tenant. Responds with `deleted: false` if the tag does not exist.

get.description: Retrieves the resources of the tenant that have the tag. Requires the resource-browser or resource-tagger role in the tenant. With includeRepresents, the directory also retrieves each represented resource from its API using the caller's token, and passes any other query parameters through to that request.

parameters.name: includeRepresents
parameters.description: Embed the represented resource of each result, for resources that match a resource type.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: Criteria for the resources to return, as JSON.

DirectoryApiName.name: api
DirectoryApiName.description: Name of the service API, usually its version, for example `v1`.

DirectoryNamespace.name: namespace
DirectoryNamespace.description: Namespace of the directory, which is the name of a tenant in kebab case (for example `test-tenant` for the tenant named Test Tenant). The namespace must match the name of a tenant; hyphens are read as spaces and the match ignores case. Read operations respond 400 when the namespace is empty or longer than 50 characters.

DirectoryServiceName.name: service
DirectoryServiceName.description: Name of the service, for example `form-service`.

ResourceAfter.name: after
ResourceAfter.description: Cursor for the page of results to retrieve, from the `next` value of the previous page.

ResourceTenantId.name: tenantId
ResourceTenantId.description: ID of the tenant to act on. Only used for core (platform) users; tenant users always act on the tenant of their token and this parameter is ignored. Without it, core users read platform (core) tags.

ResourceTop.name: top
ResourceTop.description: Number of results to retrieve. Defaults to 10.

ResourceUrnPath.name: resource
ResourceUrnPath.description: URN of the resource, URL encoded. Responds 400 if the value does not begin with `urn:ads:` or has an empty element.

DirectoryBadRequest.description: Request is invalid, for example a path parameter failed validation.

example.errorMessage: Validation failed with error(s): namespace (params) - Invalid value

DirectoryConflict.description: An entry with the name already exists in the namespace. The response has no body.

DirectoryForbidden.description: User does not have the directory-admin role in the tenant of the namespace. Anonymous requests, core users, and users of other tenants also receive this response.

example.errorMessage: User Test User (ID: 7c3e1a52-1f0b-4bd3-9a41-2b8f6c5d9e10) not permitted to updated directory.

DirectoryNamespaceNotFound.description: No tenant has the name of the namespace.

example.errorMessage: directory namespace with ID 'test-tenant' could not be found.

ResourceBadRequest.description: Request is invalid, for example a path, query, or body parameter failed validation.

example.errorMessage: Validation failed with error(s): top (query) - Invalid value

ResourceForbidden.description: User does not have a role required for the operation in the tenant. Core users without a tenant also receive this response.

example.errorMessage: User Test User (ID: 7c3e1a52-1f0b-4bd3-9a41-2b8f6c5d9e10) not permitted to get tags.

ResourceNotFound.description: The tag or resource is not found in the tenant.

example.errorMessage: tag with ID 'priority-applications' could not be found.

ResourceUnauthorized.description: Request does not include a valid bearer token. The response is the plain text `Unauthorized`.

deleted.description: False if there was nothing to delete.

urn.description: ADSP URN of the service or API.

url.description: URL of the service or API.

service.description: Name of the entry: the service name for a service entry, or `{service}:{api}` for an API entry.

DirectoryService.title: Directory service entry
DirectoryService.description: Entry as stored in the directory.

service.description: Name of the entry; `{service}:{api}` for an API entry.

host.description: URL of the service or API.

type.description: Resource type that matched the resource URN, if any.

_embedded.description: The represented resource (when `includeRepresents` is set) and the tags of the resource (when `includeTags` is set).

next.description: Cursor for requesting the next page, if any. Not set when no more results are available.

after.description: The cursor used to generate the current page. Don't use this as the `after` parameter in subsequent calls, as it repeats the page just returned.

urn.description: URN of the resource, in the form `urn:ads:{namespace}:{service}:{api}:{resource}`. The API must be registered in the directory.

tagged.description: Set for tag-resource; false if the resource already had the tag.

untagged.description: Set for untag-resource; false if the resource did not have the tag.

TagSpecification.description: Tag to apply or remove. Either label or value must be set; the value defaults to the label in kebab case.

tags.name: Directory
tags.description: Register of service and API entries in tenant namespaces, for service discovery.

tags.name: Resource
tags.description: Tags and tagged resources under APIs registered in the directory.
